tools.name: prepare_pickleball_browse
tools.description: Offer courts to play at, clubs to join, or open play sessions for a named city, state or country. Returns up to five public directory listings with MYOPL links when a category is chosen, or structured choices otherwise. Does not verify live availability or join/book anything.

tools.name: search_pickleball_rules
tools.description: Search the validated official 2026 USA Pickleball Rulebook, used by MYOPL under an official licensing agreement with USA Pickleball. Returns English evidence, edition and rule citations, plus a grounded answer when the private resolver is enabled. Preserve requests for clarification; excerpts alone

tools.name: search_myopl_help
tools.description: Find published MYOPL Help Center instructions with source URLs. No account or conversation access.

tools.name: search_myopl_website
tools.description: Find published MYOPL product and website information with source URLs. No account or conversation access.

tools.name: get_public_player_rating
tools.description: Retrieve current published OPL ratings for any exact public username without sign-in. One call returns singles, doubles and one MYOPL card in compatible clients, including Reliability Score, games played/won/lost and points won/lost. Fetch again for each new current-rating question.
